items.title: Convert cloud-native code from Azure to AWS with AWS Transform
items.summary: Introduction When you bring a cloud-native application over to AWS from another cloud, it may contain code that uses another cloud’s SDK. AWS Transform for .NET can convert code from Azure cloud-native applications to use equivalent services from AWS, helping accelerate the migration. In this post, we’ll take you on a tour of converting Azure […]
